purpose: Increase relevant scouting; reduce stale certainty; no current hidden HP/location/queue leakage

acceptance.requiredOutcome: Increase relevant scouting; reduce stale certainty; no current hidden HP/location/queue leakage
setup: Observe an enemy military group once and then remove it from line of sight without killing it
Keep an accessible last-known region and an alternative scouting route
actions: Withdraw the enemy through an ordinary move after first contact
Advance beyond the production knowledge-age threshold fixed before the run; let the AI investigate
measurements: Record source contact tick, confidence and consumed facts at each decision
Compare complete permitted digests and intents in hidden-position and hidden-HP pairs
required: Stale certainty decreases and a relevant information job receives service
Hidden movement, HP and queues cannot alter decisions before renewed contact
forbidden: Current hidden position copied into old contact
Re-reading one contact refreshes its original age
branches: Hidden position, HP and queue change independently
acceptance.checkpointPolicy: These are planned sampling ticks, not observed evidence. At binding add exact native event-boundary samples without changing the original outer ceiling; per-event capture is required where polling would miss a transient.
